setup: Fix one end of the bar in the landmine
Hold the loaded end at your chest
Feet about shoulder-width, a step from the bar
execution: Keep the bar end against your chest
Lean into the bar a little as you go
Drive up through the whole foot
faults: Don't let the bar drift away from you
Don't let your knees cave in
Don't round your back at the bottom

notes: Use a proper landmine or a corner that holds the bar end firmly, and keep the arc of the bar clear of people.
Lift the bar end from the floor to your chest with a squat, not by bending over.
Log the plates on the bar (added). The bar end rests on the floor, so you hold only part of the weight; numbers aren't comparable with a goblet or back squat.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

regressions.name: Bodyweight squat
regressions.reason: Learn the depth and stance with no load.

regressions.name: Unloaded landmine squat
regressions.reason: Just the bar; the lean into it teaches an upright squat.

progressions.name: Heavier plates
progressions.reason: Add load once depth and bar position stay the same every rep.

progressions.name: Front squat
progressions.reason: Full bar load held in front; needs more wrist and upper-back mobility.

substitutions.name: Goblet squat
substitutions.reason: Same front-loaded squat with one dumbbell; load is the dumbbell.

substitutions.name: Leg press
substitutions.reason: Quads and glutes with the back supported.

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view at hip height, figure facing right toward the landmine. The bar runs from the floor pivot up to the figure's chest, so its arc is visible.

keyPositions.label: Standing
keyPositions.describe: Standing tall, a step back from the bar, hands cupping the bar end at the upper chest. Slight lean into the bar.

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Thighs about parallel, knees over the toes, heels down. Torso fairly upright, bar end still at the chest. The bar has swung down and slightly toward the pivot along its arc.

ikHints: Bar end fixed to the hands at the chest
Far end of the bar fixed at the floor pivot
guideBrief.barPath: An arc around the floor pivot
emphasise: Upright squat with a slight lean into the bar
